def: hunger (as making to stoop with emptiness and pain)

occurrences.text: At destruction and famine thou shalt laugh: neither shalt thou be afraid of the beasts of the earth.
For want and famine they were solitary; fleeing into the wilderness in former time desolate and waste.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
